structure.unit: Franchises; Sale and Lease of Certain Municipal Public Property; Public Utilities
Approval of Water Supply Systems by Counties

law.catch_line: When approval of State Board of Health not required
law.text: The approval of the State Board of Health shall not be required unless such water supply serves or proposes to serve at least the number of persons for which the approval of the State Board of Health is required under § 32.1-172.
